purpose: Ceiling on REAL LLM-visible MCP tool calls, measured through the server tool functions under a scripted LLM that starts knowing only the goal, expect and the fields/predicates and learns control, identity and labels from each deferral. Scenarios run on REAL captured Chrome trees, on synthetic shapes for the failures a review found, and on two live findings (n=1 each, one run per cell, so not a rate). No tree captured from an unrelated real site exists yet (capturing one needs the user's consent), so every number is fixture-derived, not a claim about typical pages. Only cua_do and cua_look are visible by default (the primitives need CUA_TASK_ADVANCED=1): option B, look then plan once (CE-FACADE-005), measured with a scripted LLM that starts knowing only the goal and expect and learns the page's strings from cua_look and the plan's deferrals. The plan_* scenarios run through the real server tools on the captured booking and orders trees and on synthetic wizard, 100-row and canvas shapes (n=1 live evidence for the blind-filter failure, none yet for plans). Measured 2026-09: tools were 13% of agent wall time, the driving LLM's turns 87%; a clean booking took 9 mediated calls (native about 5) and the first live cua_do run took 8 because eight tools were visible. Any number changes only with a CE id in changed_by, and that CE's call_budget must record the same number (test_budget.py checks both; CODEOWNERS requires the policy owner's review). The scripted LLM takes its phrases from the goal, so it is a LOWER BOUND on the calls a real LLM needs and the plan_* ceilings guard call counts, not plan correctness; the vocabulary-mismatch, hidden-text, negated-dialog and undeclared-destructive scenarios (review of PR 18) measure what happens when the plan is wrong. Second review: a confirm step declares the dialog text (positive authorization), so the usual confirm flow costs one call more (press, defer with the actual dialog lines, deliberate press: 3 calls; 2 only when the wording is already known). Third review: dialog text and record text are region-complete (a confirm step also declares dialog_controls), so every confirm scenario declares controls; still fixture-derived, live exposure of images, groups, ARIA state and input values is unverified.

booking_list.description: REAL captured booking page (12 identical Book buttons in a flat AXList): fields+predicates, expect

orders_cold.description: REAL orders, LLM knows only goal, expect, predicates: control_needed -> control=Cancel -> dialog deferral -> second cua_do quoting the dialog label

orders_confirm.description: REAL orders with control and confirm known up front (identity defaults to the eq-constrained field)

confirm_deferral.description: REAL orders, control known, no confirm: dialog deferral, then a second cua_do quoting a dialog label

canvas_regions_unique.description: no AX controls; a quoted label matches ONE text region exactly; capture-bound click; the screenshot model verifies (synthetic)

canvas_regions.description: LIVE FINDING (n=1): two Export buttons drawn on a canvas labelled by Toolbar and Footer; the LLM knows only the goal: region_label_needed, then control+near (synthetic parse result)

booking_blind_predicates.description: LIVE FINDING (n=1): blind predicates (duration contains 30) vs the real "half-hour" slot: the first call MUST defer (unknown, not excluded); treat_as_match then books the right slot

large_page_400.description: 80 records, 400+ elements: response must stay small (synthetic)

stale_recovery.description: REAL booking: an unrelated text changes between observe and act; reobserve, re-run, new selection, act

driver_failure_recovered.description: REAL booking: one transient Driver failure before the click, retried inside the call

unknown_then_accept.description: REAL orders: the decoy "Walnut desk lamp shade (replacement)" is unknown for item eq; accept_unknown, then the dialog shows only the item so the LLM quotes its label

ambiguity_deferral.description: REAL booking: several eligible records, chooser abstains; the policy narrows the predicates once

per_record_labels.description: synthetic: Book Dr A / Book Dr B / Book Dr C, discovered from structure, success toast

toast_after_click.description: synthetic: success toast with an Undo button is the outcome, not a dialog

five_button_dialog.description: synthetic: a 5-button dialog is reported with all labels, then a second cua_do quoting Yes

disabled_record.description: synthetic: the matching record is disabled -> record_disabled (final status deferred, nothing the LLM can do)

toolbar_records_ambiguous.description: synthetic: records asked on a toolbar page -> records_ambiguous with the quoted-label hint, second cua_do without records

canvas_dead_end.description: synthetic: nothing to press and no quotable label -> dead_end with report_to_user (final status deferred)

plan_booking_look_do.description: REAL booking: cua_look, then cua_do steps with where.lines over the strings it showed (look_id); no reader, no chooser

plan_booking_half_hour_look_do.description: REAL booking, the live failure: the LLM SAW "half-hour" in the look and filters on it (the blind "30" is never written)

plan_booking_no_look.description: REAL booking: a where.lines plan with no look is refused before any click (look_required), then look and plan: the cost of skipping the look is one call

plan_booking_blind_fields.description: REAL booking: blind where.fields predicates still defer on "half-hour" (unknown, never excluded); treat_as_match then books the right slot (chooser picks among eligible)

plan_orders_look_do.description: REAL orders, second review: a confirm step must DECLARE the dialog text; the LLM guesses it, the plan stops confirm_dialog_unexpected_text with the ACTUAL lines (click 1 done), it reads them and presses the dialog control deliberately: look, do, do

plan_orders_identity_default.description: REAL orders: exact dialog_text declared but no identity on the press; the dialog shows only part of the default identity, so the plan stops after the first click with dialog.lines and the LLM presses the dialog control

plan_orders_wrong_dialog_guess.description: REAL orders: the press step expects dialog text the page does not show; the click is delivered and the plan stops confirm_dialog_present; a second cua_do presses the dialog control

plan_wizard_3_steps.description: synthetic 3-step wizard: cua_look, then three deterministic steps in ONE cua_do (fresh observation and new selection per step)

plan_wizard_wrong_final_label.description: synthetic wizard: the LLM guessed the last button label wrong; the plan stops at step 3 with found.controls and the earlier steps stay done

plan_invoices_100_focus.description: synthetic 100-row list shaped like the suite invoices task (near-duplicates): look(focus) then plan with where.lines; no reader

plan_invoices_100_fields.description: same 100-row list: look(focus, fields) reads the focused records in chunks (values), then the plan filters on the displayed lines

plan_canvas_look_do.description: synthetic canvas, two Export buttons: cua_look lists the drawn texts with what is near each, then one press step with control and near; the screenshot model verifies

plan_stale_mid_plan.description: synthetic wizard whose page churns after step 1: the plan stops at step 2 (ui_changed_repeatedly) with step 1 done and nothing clicked in step 2

plan_booking_vocab_mismatch.description: REAL booking, review of PR 18: the scripted LLM writes "30 min" (its own vocabulary) where the look shows "half-hour"; no_matching_record, then it goes back to the look strings and books the Telehealth slot

plan_hidden_text_negative.description: REAL booking with SOLD OUT past the 60-character cut: a not_contains condition over the cut line must stop (negative_condition_over_cut_lines), nothing clicked

plan_negated_dialog.description: REAL orders whose dialog reads "Do NOT cancel order #1044": the press lands, the confirm step must defer (confirm_dialog_negated) and press nothing further

plan_destructive_undeclared.description: a Delete account control without allow_destructive: refused before any click, even though the goal says delete

plan_destructive_declared_after_refusal.description: the same plan after the refusal, with allow_destructive naming the exact label: done

plan_orders_declared_dialog.description: REAL orders best case: the caller already knows the dialog wording and declares it exactly: look, one plan with press and confirm

plan_uniqueness_over_all_records.description: REAL booking, second review: look(focus) shows one slot but a loose condition is satisfied by 4 real records; where_matches_several (counted over ALL records), then a condition that singles it out: done

plan_hidden_text_ack.description: synthetic: the active order A has "Status: Cancelled" on line 8 past the display cut; selecting it stops selected_record_has_hidden_text (nothing clicked)

plan_hidden_text_wide_look.description: same page, look(max_lines=20, line_chars=200): the whole record is visible, so the LLM sees A is cancelled and its negative condition picks B: done

plan_checkbox_flip.description: synthetic: a checkbox flips between the look and the plan; the look_id covers control state, so the plan stops page_changed_since_look and presses nothing

plan_dialog_extra_control.description: REAL orders, third review: the dialog holds a pre-checked "Also delete my account" box the caller did not declare in dialog_controls; the confirm defers confirm_dialog_unexpected_text with the actual controls and states and presses nothing further

plan_image_badge_seen.description: synthetic, third review: order 1 carries an image labelled "Cancelled"; the look shows it as an "image: Cancelled" line, so the LLM picks order 2 instead of clicking the cancelled one
